notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Planar Bridge by paying {8} and tapping it, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
